bio: I'm a software engineer working on backend systems and integrating AI into production workflows. At Ethos Life I sit on the underwriting team, improving a highly deterministic underwriting engine with AI-assisted capabilities while keeping accuracy and reliability intact.

I have a strong foundation in Python, C++, APIs, and scalable systems, with hands-on experience deploying ML/LLM services. I graduated from R.V. College of Engineering in 2026 with a B.E. in Electronics and Communication.
education: B.E. Electronics and Communication, R.V. College of Engineering

experience.desc: Improving a highly deterministic underwriting engine with AI-assisted decisioning. Led the AI platform for underwriting, translating model outputs into controlled production flows and helping improve manual underwriting and strategy-team efficiency by 50%.

Reconstructed an Android app at the system level from APK (40% faster debugging), improved runtime by 50% via multithreading and memory work, and integrated a custom neural network into OS-level multimedia libraries at 84% accuracy.
